BillingBot: Auto-charge completed 2026-05-12T03:12Z for INV-2026-0789 (charge CHG-99a7).

acme,2600,true,2026-02-01_to_2026-02-14

Drop after 2026-02-15 ~60% so proration applies.

BillingBot: Audit flag set: INV-2026-0789 marked for manual review at 2026-05-12T03:20Z.

Carlos (RevOps): Provisional approval to issue a credit memo up to $20k pending final reconciled total and Legal sign-off on amendment wording. Route via billing@redwood.com and cc RevOps.

Sam (Finance): Hold any refund until Legal signs off. Priya, include committed-throughput true-up and any penalties.

Marta (CS): Customer prefers credit on next invoice. I'll upload the signed amendment once received. Target to resolve before renewal 2026-06-30.

Sam (Finance): Received. Will queue Legal review. Thanks team.
